_meta.purpose: Problem bank for RecognitionDrill. Each entry: statement (hide the pattern tag from the reader), pattern slug (correct answer), subVariation slug (optional, the specialization), distractors (other patterns the problem could plausibly be mistaken for). The reader is shown the statement with no tag and guesses pattern + subVariation.

schema.statement: problem statement string — must not name the pattern or sub-variation
schema.distractors: array of pattern slugs the problem could plausibly be mistaken for

binary-search.statement: Given a sorted integer array nums and a target value, return the index of target. If not present, return -1.
You are given a sorted array that has been rotated at some unknown pivot. Find a target value in O(log n) time.
Find a peak element in an array where a peak is any element strictly greater than its neighbours. Multiple peaks may exist; return any index. Must be O(log n).
You are given an m×n integer matrix where every row is sorted left-to-right AND the first number of each row is greater than the last of the previous row. Search for a target in O(log(mn)).
Given a sorted array with duplicates, return the leftmost and rightmost indices of a target value. Return [-1,-1] if absent.
Given a sorted array of N integers, return the smallest index i such that nums[i] >= target.
A conveyor belt processes packages. Given weights[] and D days, find the minimum belt capacity so that all packages ship within D days, in order.
Koko eats bananas from piles[]. She eats k bananas per hour. If a pile has fewer than k, she eats all of them and stops for the hour. Find the smallest k that lets her finish in h hours.
Given two sorted arrays of total size n+m, find the overall median in O(log(min(n,m))).
Given a mountain array (strictly increasing then strictly decreasing) and a target, find the smallest index with that value in O(log n).

sliding-window.statement: Given an integer array and k, find the contiguous subarray of length k that has the maximum average value.
Given a positive integer array and target S, find the smallest contiguous subarray whose sum is at least S. Return its length (0 if none).
Given a string, find the length of the longest substring that contains no repeating characters.
Given strings s and t, find the smallest window in s that contains every character of t (with multiplicity). Return "" if none.
You can change at most k characters in a string. Find the length of the longest substring containing one repeated letter after your changes.
Given a positive integer array and k, count the number of contiguous subarrays whose product is strictly less than k.
Given an integer array and k, return the maximum of each contiguous window of size k in O(n) total time.
Given a sorted integer array, return a new array of the squares of each number, also sorted. Must be O(n).
Given an array of integers, find all unique triplets (a, b, c) such that a + b + c = 0.
Given a string of lowercase letters, find the length of the longest substring where every character appears at most twice.

two-pointers.statement: Given a sorted array and a target, return indices of two numbers summing to target (1-indexed).
Given an array of heights, pick two to form a container holding the most water with the x-axis.
Find all unique triplets in nums that sum to zero.
Given a sorted array possibly containing negatives, return the sorted squares of each element in O(n).
Remove duplicates from a sorted array in place and return the new length.
Sort an array containing only 0s, 1s, and 2s in a single pass in place.
Given an elevation map, compute how much rainwater is trapped between the bars.
Decide whether a string is a palindrome (ignoring non-alphanumerics and case).
Move all zeros in an integer array to the end while preserving the relative order of non-zero elements.
Given two sorted integer arrays, merge them into the first in place in O(m+n).

fast-slow.statement: Given the head of a singly linked list, return true if the list contains a cycle, else false.
Given the head of a linked list, return the node where the cycle begins, or null if there is no cycle.
Given a non-empty linked list, return the middle node. If there are two middle nodes, return the second one.
Remove the nth node from the end of a singly linked list and return the head, in one pass with O(1) extra space.
A happy number is defined by repeatedly replacing a positive integer with the sum of the squares of its digits. Return true if the sequence eventually reaches 1.
Given an array of n+1 integers where each value is in [1, n], find the one duplicate value without modifying the array and using only O(1) extra space.
Given a singly linked list, determine whether it is a palindrome using O(1) extra space.
Reorder a linked list L0 -> L1 -> ... -> Ln-1 to L0 -> Ln-1 -> L1 -> Ln-2 -> ... in O(1) extra space.
Given a deterministic sequence x_{n+1} = f(x_n), decide whether it eventually enters a cycle, using only two pointers and no extra memory.
Given a linked list that may contain a cycle, return the length of the cycle (0 if none), using O(1) extra space.

prefix-sum.statement: Many range-sum queries on a static array of 10^5 numbers; up to 10^5 queries.
Count contiguous subarrays whose sum equals k; array may contain negative numbers.
You get m range-add updates [l,r,v] on a length-n array, then one final read of the array.
Preprocess a 200×200 matrix so each sub-rectangle sum query answers in O(1).
Count contiguous subarrays whose XOR equals k, given an array of non-negative integers.
Count contiguous subarrays whose sum is divisible by k, allowing negative values.
Given a 0/1 array, find the length of the longest contiguous subarray with equal 0s and 1s.
n flight segments, m bookings each adding seats to a range of flights; return per-flight totals.
A car has capacity C and takes passengers along a timeline with pick-up/drop-off intervals; can every ride be served?
Count submatrices of a matrix whose sum equals k; matrix up to 100×100.

hashing.statement: Given an array and target, return indices of two numbers summing to target.
Given a SORTED array and target, return 1-indexed indices of two numbers summing to target.
Group words that are anagrams of each other.
Find the length of the longest run of consecutive integers in an unsorted array (O(n)).
Given an integer array and k, count subarrays whose sum equals k.
Return the k most frequent elements of an integer array in O(n) expected time.
Decide whether two strings are isomorphic (one-to-one character mapping).
Find all unique numbers that appear more than n/3 times in an array.
Given a long document, print the frequency of each word in descending order.
Given an array where each element appears twice except one, find that single element.

monotonic-stack.statement: Given an array of daily temperatures, for each day return the number of days you have to wait for a warmer temperature; 0 if none.
Return an array where answer[i] is the next greater element to the right of nums[i], or -1 if none.
Given a circular integer array, find the next greater number for every element; the next greater number of x is the first larger number encountered when traversing the array moving forward.
Given a histogram where bar widths are 1, return the area of the largest rectangle that fits entirely under the bars.
Given a 2D binary matrix of 0s and 1s, find the largest rectangle containing only 1s.
Design a class that collects daily stock prices and returns the span of each day's price — the number of consecutive days ending today that had a price less than or equal to today's.
Given a non-negative integer num represented as a string, remove k digits from it so the resulting number is the smallest possible; return as a string.
Given a string s, return the lexicographically smallest subsequence of s that contains all the distinct characters of s exactly once.
Given an integer array nums, return true if there is a triplet (i, j, k) with i < j < k and nums[i] < nums[k] < nums[j].
Given an array of integers, for each element find the SUM of minimums over every contiguous subarray; return the total modulo 10^9+7.

bs-on-answer.statement: Minimum truck capacity so that packages can be shipped in order within D days.
Minimum eating speed k so Koko finishes all piles within H hours (one pile per hour).
Smallest positive integer divisor so that the sum of ceilDiv(nums[i], d) is ≤ threshold.
Split an array into m contiguous subarrays to minimize the largest subarray sum.
Find the median of two sorted arrays in O(log(min(m,n))).
Place K cows in stalls on a line so the minimum distance between any two cows is maximized.
Smallest max working-hours per subarray when splitting workers into K teams of contiguous tasks.
Minimum number of days needed to make m bouquets of k adjacent flowers each.
Find the K-th smallest pair distance in an unsorted integer array.
Find the maximum capacity load so a boat can ferry all passengers across in ≤ T trips.

k-way-merge.statement: Given k sorted linked lists, merge them into one sorted list.
Given two sorted integer arrays u and v, return the k pairs (u[i], v[j]) with the smallest sums.
Design a stream data structure that supports addNum(x) and findMedian() in O(log n) and O(1).
Given k sorted lists, find the smallest range that contains at least one number from each list.
Find the kth smallest element in an n×n matrix sorted ascending in both rows and columns.
Return the n-th ugly number — the n-th positive integer whose prime factors are only 2, 3, 5.
In a stream of integers, after each insert, print the current median (or report it on demand).
You have k log files sorted by timestamp. Produce a single globally-sorted stream of lines without loading all files in memory.
Given two sorted lists of candidate costs, return the k itineraries with the lowest total cost.
Running finance data: compute the median of the last k trade prices after every new tick.

merge-intervals.statement: Given a list of intervals, merge all overlapping intervals and return the disjoint result.
Given a sorted, non-overlapping list of intervals and a new interval, insert it and return the merged list in one pass.
Return the minimum number of intervals to remove so the rest are non-overlapping.
Given an array of meeting intervals, determine whether one person can attend all of them.
Given a list of busy intervals from several calendars, return the free intervals in a given day.
Given two sorted lists of non-overlapping intervals, return their intersections.
Given a list of intervals, remove intervals that are completely covered by another and return the count that remains.
You are given CPU jobs with [start, end] times; find the max profit non-overlapping subset you can schedule where each job has a weight (weighted interval scheduling).
Insert a new interval into a sorted interval list and return the number of merged intervals in O(n).
Given scheduled meetings as [start, end], decide whether any pair conflicts; return a boolean.

sweep-line.statement: Given a list of meeting intervals, find the minimum number of conference rooms required.
Given a list of trips [passengers, from, to] and a car capacity, decide whether the car can pick up and drop off all passengers without exceeding capacity.
Given the positions and heights of buildings, return the skyline silhouette as a list of key points.
Given each employee's busy time intervals, return the common free time across all employees.
At what moment in a day is the maximum number of users logged in simultaneously?
Design a calendar that rejects triple-bookings; return whether an event can be added.
Given train arrival and departure times, return the minimum platforms needed so no train waits.
Find the total length of the real line covered by at least one of n given intervals (coverage sweep).
Given rectangles aligned to the axes, compute their total covered area (Klee's problem, 1D of 2D sweep).
Given a stream of booking intervals, after each booking report the current maximum number of overlapping events.

topological-sort.statement: You have numCourses courses labeled 0..numCourses-1 and prerequisite pairs [a,b] meaning you must finish b before a. Return true iff all courses can be finished.
Given numCourses and prerequisite pairs, return a valid order to take all courses, or an empty array if a cycle exists.
Given a list of words sorted lexicographically according to an unknown alien alphabet, return the alphabet or an empty string if impossible.
Given an undirected tree with n nodes, return all possible root choices such that the resulting tree has minimum height.

You have n courses and prerequisite relations [u, v] meaning u must be taken before v. If multiple courses may be taken in parallel each semester, return the minimum number of semesters to finish all courses.
Given an original permutation of 1..n and a list of sub-sequences, verify that the original is the UNIQUE topological order consistent with all sub-sequences.

You have a build system with files that depend on each other via include directives. Return a compilation order such that each file is compiled after all its dependencies, or detect that a circular dependency exists.
Given a project with tasks and their dependencies, each task takes 1 unit of time, and parallel execution is allowed. Return the minimum completion time or -1 if impossible.
Given a directed graph, determine the longest path length. Edges are unweighted and the graph is guaranteed to be acyclic.
You are given an undirected graph that forms a tree. For each query, you must find the root that minimizes the maximum depth. Return all such roots.

union-find.statement: You are given a 2D array isConnected where isConnected[i][j]=1 if city i and city j are directly connected; return the number of provinces (connected groups).

Given a list of accounts where each account is a list [name, email1, email2, ...], merge accounts that belong to the same person (share any email); return merged accounts with emails sorted lexicographically.
A tree is given with one extra edge added. Return the edge that, when removed, leaves a valid tree. If multiple answers exist, return the one that appears last in the input.
You are given 2D points on a plane. Return the minimum cost to connect ALL points, where the cost between two points is the Manhattan distance.
Given n nodes labeled 0..n-1 and a list of undirected edges, determine if these edges form a valid tree (connected and acyclic).

You are given a grid of elevations. Water rises uniformly over time. Return the minimum time at which you can swim from (0,0) to (n-1,n-1) moving only between adjacent cells both at elevation <= current time.
You are given n stones at integer coordinates; a stone can be removed if it shares a row or column with another remaining stone. Return the maximum number of stones that can be removed.
You are given an m x n binary grid and a stream of positions where each position turns a cell from water to land. After each addition, return the number of islands.
Given a list of equations like 'a==b' and 'c!=d', determine whether all equations can be simultaneously satisfied by some assignment of variable values.
You have a 2D matrix. Replace each element with its 'rank', where rank is defined so that same-row and same-column cells with the same value get the same rank, and the smallest value gets rank 1.

greedy.statement: Pack the maximum number of non-overlapping meetings into one conference room.
Minimum intervals to remove so remaining don't overlap.
Reach the last index with the fewest jumps where each cell is a max step length.
Pick the starting fuel station on a circular route so you can complete the loop.
Schedule tasks with cooldown n between identical labels; minimize total time including idles.
Build a prefix code that minimizes the weighted total bit-length over character frequencies.
Fewest arrows to pop all balloons each pinned to an interval of x-coordinates.
Max profit on one buy/sell transaction given daily stock prices.
Longest chain of pairs where next pair's first > previous pair's second.
Fewest video clips to cover [0, T] from an unsorted set of intervals.

backtracking.statement: Enumerate all 2^n subsets of a set of distinct integers.
Enumerate all C(n,k) combinations of size k from n distinct integers.
Enumerate all n! permutations of n distinct integers, mutating a used[] flag array.
Enumerate all n! permutations by swapping positions in-place.
Find all unique ways to sum to a target using candidates (unlimited reuse).
Place N queens on an N×N board with no two attacking.
Decide whether a word appears as a path in a letter grid (no cell reuse).
Return all possible letter strings that a phone-digit sequence could spell.
Partition a string so every substring is a palindrome; return all partitions.
Solve a 9×9 Sudoku board by filling blank cells with 1-9 respecting row/column/box constraints.

divide-conquer.statement: Sort an array of n integers in O(n log n) worst case, stable, using O(n) extra space.
Compute x^n for real x and integer n (positive or negative) in O(log n) multiplications.
For each element, return how many elements to its right are strictly smaller.
Given an array where some element appears more than n/2 times, return that majority element.
Count the total number of inversions (i<j with a[i]>a[j]) in an array of n integers.
Count pairs (i,j) with i<j and a[i] > 2*a[j] in an integer array.
Compute a mod exponent b^e mod m efficiently (log e multiplications).
Sort a singly-linked list in O(n log n) time and O(log n) stack space.
Count the number of subarrays whose sum lies in [lower, upper].
A tournament dataset shows one candidate on >50% of ballots. Find that candidate.

dp.statement: Compute Fibonacci numbers in O(n) time, O(1) space using a rolling pair.
Count the ways to climb n stairs taking 1 or 2 steps at a time.
Maximum sum of a contiguous subarray in a signed integer array (Kadane).
Given item weights/values and a capacity, maximize value with each item 0/1 included.
Fewest coins (unlimited supply of each denomination) that sum to an amount.
Count unique paths from top-left to bottom-right of an m×n grid moving right or down.
Length of the longest increasing subsequence in an integer array.
Minimum operations (insert/delete/replace) to transform one string into another.
Minimize the cost of multiplying a chain of matrices by choosing parenthesization.
Max profit from unlimited stock buy/sell transactions with a 1-day cooldown between sells.
Shortest tour visiting all n cities exactly once and returning to the start (n ≤ 20).
Max money a thief can rob from a tree of houses, no parent and child both robbed.

bit-manip.statement: Extract the lowest set bit of an integer in O(1).
Find the unique number in an array where every other number appears twice.
Find the unique number where every other number appears three times.
Find the two unique numbers where every other number appears twice.
Count the number of set bits in each integer from 0 to n.
Reverse the 32 bits of an unsigned integer.
Determine if a non-negative integer is a power of two in O(1).
Enumerate all 2^n subsets of an n-element set using integer masks 0..2^n-1.
Swap two integers without using a temporary variable.
Count the total number of set bits across all integers 0..n efficiently.

quickselect.statement: Find the k-th largest element in an unsorted array in expected O(n) time without doing a full sort.
Return the median of an unsorted array in O(n) expected time with O(1) extra space.
Given n points in 2D, return the k closest to the origin in any order, in expected O(n) time.
Rearrange an unsorted array so nums[0] < nums[1] > nums[2] < nums[3] > ... in-place in O(n) expected time (Wiggle Sort II).
Find the k-th smallest element in an unsorted array; mutation is allowed; O(n) expected is required.
Find the top-k most frequent elements in an array where k is much smaller than n, in expected O(n) time.
Given an unsorted array, return any element at rank r in expected linear time without sorting.
You are implementing a C stdlib replacement: write nth_element(a, p) so that a[p] holds the final sorted value at position p after one call, in expected linear time.
Compare the Hoare and Lomuto partition schemes for in-place selection; implement one that is bug-safe on duplicate-heavy inputs.
In an image-denoising pipeline, apply a median filter: for each 3x3 window return the median of 9 pixels.
